answer: Each identity's usable standing is released only after a sequential, non-transferable custody period, and the release rate is super-linear in how many identities an operator runs, so a fleet cannot mature faster than one identity at a time. The cost of one more head is paid in full and is never amortised across the fleet. The pulse is the serial tenure, the terrace the custody window that must elapse, and the mirror the standing released at the end of it; the pulse is personal, the terrace is not skippable, and the mirror cannot be inherited by a sibling.
